Zhou royal domain.name: Ji Quji
Zhou royal domain.title: King Ai of Zhou
Zhou royal domain.note: Killed by his brother after about three months.
Zhou royal domain.note_zh: 在位约三个月即被弟弟所杀。

Zhou royal domain.name: Ji Shu
Zhou royal domain.title: King Si of Zhou
Zhou royal domain.note: Killed by his brother after about five months.
Zhou royal domain.note_zh: 在位约五个月即被弟弟所杀。

Zhou royal domain.name: Ji Wu
Zhou royal domain.title: King Weilie of Zhou
Zhou royal domain.note: In 403 BCE he recognized Han, Zhao and Wei as ruling houses.
Zhou royal domain.note_zh: 前403年正式承认韩、赵、魏为诸侯。

Zhou royal domain.name: Ji Yan
Zhou royal domain.title: King Nan of Zhou
Zhou royal domain.note: The last Zhou king; Qin ended the dynasty in 256 BCE.
Zhou royal domain.note_zh: 周朝最后一位天子，前256年秦灭周。

Jin.name: Ji Zao
Jin.title: Duke Chu of Jin
Jin.note: Driven out by the great ministerial families.

Jin.name: Ji Jiao
Jin.title: Duke Ai of Jin
Jin.note: Also called Duke Jing or Duke Yi. Real power lay with the Zhao, Han and Wei families.
Jin.note_zh: 又称晋敬公、晋懿公。实权掌握在赵、韩、魏三家手中。

Jin.name: Ji Julu
Jin.title: Duke Jing of Jin
Jin.note: The last ruler of Jin; the Zhao, Han and Wei families took the rest of his land. The Records of the Grand Historian date the end of Jin to 376 BCE.
Jin.note_zh: 晋国最后一位国君，余地被三家瓜分。《史记》记晋亡于前376年。

check.n: Wikipedia: Jing of Jin enthroned 378 BC (ZZTJ) or 356 BC (Shiji), deposed 376 or 349 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科：晋静公即位于前378年（资治通鉴）或前356年（史记），被废于前376年或前349年。

Zhongshan.name: Cuo
Zhongshan.title: King Cuo of Zhongshan
Zhongshan.note: Known mainly from inscribed bronzes in his tomb at Pingshan, Hebei. Other Zhongshan rulers' dates are uncertain.
Zhongshan.note_zh: 主要见于河北平山王墓出土的铭文铜器。中山国其他君主年代不详。

check.n: English Wikipedia: second reign ended 470 BC; Chinese says died 456 BC.
check.n_zh: 英文维基百科称复位后于前470年被推翻；中文称前456年卒。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: died 465 BC after 5 years on throne.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科：前465年卒，在位5年。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 371 BC – 343 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前371年—前343年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 343 BC – 335 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前343年—前335年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 334 BC – 293 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前334年—前293年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 292 BC – 252 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前292年—前252年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

Wey.name: Jue
Wey.title: Lord Jue of Wey
Wey.note: Wey survived as a tiny Qin dependency until the Second Emperor removed him in 209 BCE.
Wey.note_zh: 卫国作为秦的附庸苟存，至前209年被秦二世废为庶人。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 241 BC – 209 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前241年—前209年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

Qi.name: Jiang Ao
Qi.title: Duke Ping of Qi
Qi.note: Real power lay with the Tian family.

Qi.name: Jiang Dai
Qi.title: Duke Kang of Qi
Qi.note: Pushed aside by Tian He; the Jiang line ended with his death in 379 BCE.
Qi.note_zh: 被田和架空并迁居海滨，前379年去世，姜姓齐国绝祀。

Qi.name: Tian He
Qi.title: Duke Tai of Tian Qi
Qi.note: Recognized by the Zhou king as ruler of Qi in 386 BCE (the 'Tian family takes Qi').
Qi.note_zh: 前386年被周天子正式列为诸侯，即“田氏代齐”。

Qi.name: Tian Yinqi
Qi.title: King Wei of Qi
Qi.note: The Records of the Grand Historian give 378-343 BCE; the dates here follow the Bamboo Annals.
Qi.note_zh: 《史记》作前378—前343年，此处依《竹书纪年》。

Lu.name: Ji Ning
Lu.title: Duke Dao of Lu
Lu.note: Dates for this state's rulers differ between the Records of the Grand Historian and the Bamboo Annals.
Lu.note_zh: 这一时期该国君主的年代，《史记》与《竹书纪年》记载不一。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: died 377 BC, reigned 33 years.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科：前377年卒，在位33年。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 382 BC – 353 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前382年—前353年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 352 BC – 344 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前352年—前344年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 343 BC – 323 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前343年—前323年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

Lu.name: Ji Chou
Lu.title: Duke Qing of Lu
Lu.note: Chu annexed Lu in 256 BCE; he died a commoner.
Lu.note_zh: 前256年楚灭鲁，他被废为平民。

Song.name: Zi Touman
Song.title: Duke Jing of Song
Song.note: Dates for this state's rulers differ between the Records of the Grand Historian and the Bamboo Annals.
Song.note_zh: 这一时期该国君主的年代，《史记》与《竹书纪年》记载不一。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 516 BC – 469 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前516年—前469年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: died 385 BC after 8 years on throne.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科：前385年卒，在位8年。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: usurped c. 356-350 BC; 27th year is 329 BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科：约前356至前350年篡位；二十七年为前329年。

Song.name: Yan
Song.title: King Kang of Song
Song.note: Took the title of king; killed when Qi conquered Song in 286 BCE.
Song.note_zh: 自立为王，前286年齐灭宋时被杀。

Zheng.name: Ji Yi
Zheng.title: Duke Kang of Zheng
Zheng.note: Last ruler; Han annexed Zheng in 375 BCE.
Zheng.note_zh: 郑国末代君主，前375年韩灭郑。

Chu.name: Xiong Huai
Chu.title: King Huai of Chu
Chu.note: Lured to Qin and held there until his death in 296 BCE.
Chu.note_zh: 被骗入秦后遭扣留，前296年死于秦。

Chu.name: Lord Changping
Chu.title: Lord Changping
Chu.note: Set up as king by Xiang Yan after Fuchu's capture; killed when Qin finished off Chu.
Chu.note_zh: 负刍被俘后由项燕拥立为楚王，秦灭楚时战死。

Yan.name: Duke Xian of Yan
Yan.title: Duke Xian of Yan
Yan.note: Dates for this state's rulers differ between the Records of the Grand Historian and the Bamboo Annals.
Yan.note_zh: 这一时期该国君主的年代，《史记》与《竹书纪年》记载不一。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: died 455 BC after 38 years on throne.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科：前455年卒，在位38年。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 454 BC – 439 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前454年—前439年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 438 BC – 415 BC; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作前438年—前415年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

Yan.name: King Yi of Yan
Yan.title: King Yi of Yan
Yan.note: First ruler of Yan to call himself king.
Yan.note_zh: 燕国第一位称王的君主。

Yan.name: Kuai
Yan.title: Kuai, King of Yan
Yan.note: Handed the throne to his minister Zizhi, which led to civil war and a Qi invasion.
Yan.note_zh: 把王位让给相国子之，引发内乱和齐国入侵。

Yan.name: Zizhi
Yan.title: Zizhi
Yan.note: Minister who received the throne; killed when Qi invaded.
Yan.note_zh: 受让王位的相国，齐军入侵时被杀。

Yan.name: Ji Zhi
Yan.title: King Zhao of Yan
Yan.note: Rebuilt Yan and sent Yue Yi against Qi.
Yan.note_zh: 招贤纳士重振燕国，派乐毅伐齐。

Yan.name: Ji Xi
Yan.title: Xi, King of Yan
Yan.note: Captured by Qin in Liaodong in 222 BCE.
Yan.note_zh: 前222年在辽东被秦军俘虏。

Qin.name: Ying Chang
Qin.title: Chuzi of Qin
Qin.note: A child ruler, killed in a coup.
Qin.note_zh: 幼年即位，在政变中被杀。

Qin.name: Ying Quliang
Qin.title: Duke Xiao of Qin
Qin.note: Backed Shang Yang's reforms, which made Qin strong.
Qin.note_zh: 任用商鞅变法，秦国从此强大。

Qin.name: Ying Si
Qin.title: King Huiwen of Qin
Qin.note: Took the title of king in 325 BCE.

Qin.name: Ying Ji
Qin.title: King Zhaoxiang of Qin
Qin.note: His general Bai Qi won at Yique and Changping.
Qin.note_zh: 大将白起在伊阙、长平大胜。

Qin.name: Ying Zhu
Qin.title: King Xiaowen of Qin
Qin.note: Died days after his formal accession.
Qin.note_zh: 正式即位后数日即去世。

Qin.name: Ying Zheng
Qin.title: Zheng, King of Qin
Qin.note: Became the First Emperor in 221 BCE.

Yue.name: Lüying
Yue.title: Lüying, King of Yue
Yue.note: Also written Shiying (鼫与). Later Yue rulers and dates are poorly recorded.
Yue.note_zh: 又作鼫与。此后越国君主及年代记载不清。

Han.name: Han Hu
Han.title: Viscount Kang of Han
Han.note: Head of the Han family, one of three that destroyed the Zhi at Jinyang.
Han.note_zh: 韩氏宗主，晋阳之战灭智氏的三家之一。

Han.name: Han Qian
Han.title: Marquis Jing of Han
Han.note: Recognized as a ruler by the Zhou king in 403 BCE.
Han.note_zh: 前403年被周天子列为诸侯。

Han.name: Han Ruoshan
Han.title: Marquis Yi of Han
Han.note: Also called Marquis Gong or Zhuang.

Han.name: Han An
Han.title: An, King of Han
Han.note: Captured when Qin took Han in 230 BCE.

Wei.name: Wei Ju
Wei.title: Viscount Huan of Wei
Wei.note: Head of the Wei family at the Battle of Jinyang.

Wei.name: Wei Si
Wei.title: Marquis Wen of Wei
Wei.note: Employed Li Kui and Wu Qi; Wei led the states in his time.
Wei.note_zh: 任用李悝、吴起，魏国称雄一时。

Wei.name: Wei Ying
Wei.title: King Hui of Wei
Wei.note: Moved the capital to Daliang; also called King Hui of Liang.

Wei.name: Wei Jia
Wei.title: Jia, King of Wei
Wei.note: Surrendered when Qin flooded Daliang in 225 BCE.
Wei.note_zh: 前225年秦军水淹大梁后投降。

Zhao.name: Zhao Wuxu
Zhao.title: Viscount Xiang of Zhao
Zhao.note: Led the defence of Jinyang against the Zhi family.
Zhao.note_zh: 晋阳之战中坚守晋阳，联合韩、魏灭智氏。

Zhao.name: Zhao Ji
Zhao.title: Marquis Lie of Zhao
Zhao.note: Recognized as a ruler by the Zhou king in 403 BCE.
Zhao.note_zh: 前403年被周天子列为诸侯。

Zhao.name: Zhao Yong
Zhao.title: King Wuling of Zhao
Zhao.note: Introduced nomad dress and mounted archery; abdicated in 299 BCE and died in 295 BCE.
Zhao.note_zh: 推行胡服骑射，前299年传位，前295年去世。

Zhao.name: Zhao Qian
Zhao.title: Qian, King of Zhao
Zhao.note: Captured when Qin took Handan in 228 BCE.

Dai.name: Zhao Jia
Dai.title: Jia, King of Dai
Dai.note: Zhao prince who held out in Dai until Qin captured him.
Dai.note_zh: 赵国公子，在代地坚持抵抗，最终被秦军俘获。

yue-wu.note: Yue besieged the Wu capital for about three years before it fell.
yue-wu.note_zh: 越军围困吴都约三年后将其攻破。
yue-wu.losses: King Fuchai of Wu killed himself

jinyang.note: Zhi flooded Jinyang by diverting a river, but Han and Wei, who had been fighting for him, secretly changed sides.
jinyang.note_zh: 智伯引水灌晋阳，原本随他围城的韩、魏两家暗中倒戈。
jinyang.losses: Zhi Yao killed and his family wiped out

guiling.note: Instead of marching to Handan, Qi threatened the Wei capital Daliang and ambushed the Wei army as it hurried home.
guiling.note_zh: 齐军不直接救邯郸，而是进逼魏都大梁，在魏军回救途中设伏击败之。

maling.note: Sun Bin made fewer cooking fires each day to fake desertions, then ambushed the pursuing Wei army with massed crossbows.
maling.note_zh: 孙膑逐日减灶，假装士卒逃散，再以万弩伏击追来的魏军。
maling.losses: Pang Juan died; Crown Prince Shen captured

qin-bashu.note: Qin went in at the invitation of Ba, then took both Shu and Ba.
qin-bashu.note_zh: 秦借巴、蜀相攻之机出兵，先灭蜀，后取巴。

hu-fu.note: A series of campaigns, not one battle: Zhao won land in the north and built a wall up to Gaoque.
hu-fu.note_zh: 这是一系列征战而非单场战役：赵国向北拓地，筑长城至高阙。

zhao-zhongshan.note: Zhao attacked Zhongshan in several campaigns from 307 BCE before ending it.
zhao-zhongshan.note_zh: 赵国自前307年起多次进攻中山，最终将其灭亡。
zhao-zhongshan.losses: King of Zhongshan exiled to Fushi

yique.note: The number comes from Qin's claimed beheadings and may be inflated.
yique.note_zh: 数字来自秦国报功的斩首数，可能有夸大。
yique.losses: 240,000 Han and Wei soldiers said killed; Gongsun Xi captured
yique.losses_zh: 据称韩魏联军被斩首24万，公孙喜被俘

qi-song.losses: King Kang of Song killed while fleeing

yue-yi.note: Qin, Han, Zhao and Wei joined Yan at first. In 279 BCE Tian Dan broke out of Jimo with his fire-oxen and won back the lost cities.
yue-yi.note_zh: 秦、韩、赵、魏起初与燕联合伐齐。前279年田单以火牛阵从即墨反击，收复失地。
yue-yi.losses: Qi lost over 70 cities; King Min killed
yue-yi.losses_zh: 齐失七十余城，齐湣王被杀

changping.note: The traditional figures are probably inflated. Zhao replaced the cautious Lian Po with the young Zhao Kuo, who was surrounded and killed.
changping.note_zh: 传统数字可能有夸大。赵国以年轻的赵括替换持重的廉颇，赵括被围战死。
changping.losses: The Records of the Grand Historian say 450,000 Zhao soldiers died, most after surrendering
changping.losses_zh: 《史记》称赵军先后损失45万人，大多是投降后被坑杀

sides.name: Wei and Chu relief armies
sides.troops_text: 80,000 picked Wei troops, plus Chu forces

handan-siege.note: Lord Xinling stole Wei's army tally to take command of the 80,000 troops (窃符救赵).
handan-siege.note_zh: 信陵君窃取兵符，夺得魏军八万精兵救赵，即“窃符救赵”。
handan-siege.losses: Zheng Anping surrendered with 20,000 Qin men
handan-siege.losses_zh: 秦将郑安平率两万人投降

qin-zhao.note: Zhao's best general Li Mu had been executed after Qin bribed a Zhao minister to slander him.
qin-zhao.note_zh: 秦国收买赵臣进谗，赵王杀了名将李牧。

qin-wei.note: Qin flooded Daliang for three months until its walls collapsed.
qin-wei.note_zh: 秦军引河水灌大梁三个月，城墙崩坏。

qin-chu.note: An earlier Qin army of about 200,000 under Li Xin had been beaten by Chu in 225 BCE.
qin-chu.note_zh: 前225年李信率约20万秦军攻楚曾遭惨败。
qin-chu.losses: Xiang Yan died; King Fuchu captured
qin-chu.losses_zh: 项燕战死，楚王负刍被俘

qin-yan.note: After Jing Ke's failed attempt to kill the King of Qin (227 BCE), Qin took the Yan capital Ji and then hunted the court down in Liaodong.
qin-yan.note_zh: 荆轲刺秦王失败（前227年）后，秦军攻下燕都蓟，又追至辽东。
qin-yan.losses: Kings of Yan and Dai captured

routes.name: Qin conquers the six states
routes.summary: Qin's armies took Han (230), Zhao (228), the Yan capital Ji (226), Wei (225), Chu (223) and the Yan court in Liaodong (222); Qi surrendered in 221.
routes.summary_zh: 秦军依次攻灭韩（前230年）、赵（前228年），攻破燕都蓟（前226年），灭魏（前225年）、楚（前223年），前222年在辽东俘燕王；前221年齐国投降。

routes.name: Yue Yi's invasion of Qi
routes.summary: Yue Yi led Yan and its allies south, beat Qi west of the Ji River, took Linzi and over 70 cities, leaving only Ju and Jimo.
routes.summary_zh: 乐毅率燕及联军南下，在济西大败齐军，攻占临淄等七十余城，只剩莒和即墨未下。

routes.name: Qin conquers Ba and Shu
routes.summary: Sima Cuo's army crossed the Qinling and the Shu roads to Chengdu, then turned east to take Ba.
routes.summary_zh: 司马错率秦军翻越秦岭、经蜀道直下成都，又东取巴国。

routes.name: Wall of King Zhaoxiang of Qin
routes.summary: After destroying the Yiqu, Qin built a wall from Lintao across the Loess Plateau to the Yellow River (route approximate; date c. 271 BCE).
routes.summary_zh: 秦灭义渠后修筑长城，自临洮横贯黄土高原直到黄河边（走向为大致示意，约建于前271年）。

routes.name: Zhao's northern wall
routes.summary: After his campaigns against the Linhu and Loufan, King Wuling of Zhao walled the land from Dai along the Yin Mountains to Gaoque (route approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 赵武灵王击败林胡、楼烦后，自代地沿阴山筑长城至高阙（走向为大致示意）。

routes.name: Yan's northern wall
routes.summary: After General Qin Kai drove back the Donghu, Yan walled its north from Zaoyang to Xiangping in Liaodong (route and date approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 燕将秦开击退东胡后，燕国自造阳至辽东襄平修筑长城（走向与年代均为大致）。

routes.name: Zhengguo Canal
routes.summary: Begun in 246 BCE, it led the Jing River east to the Luo River and turned the Guanzhong plain into Qin's granary.
routes.summary_zh: 前246年开凿，引泾水东注洛水，使关中平原成为秦国粮仓。

routes.name: Hong Canal
routes.summary: Wei dug this canal from the Yellow River past Daliang to the Huai river system (start date approximate).
routes.summary_zh: 魏国开凿鸿沟，引黄河水经大梁南通淮河水系（始凿年代为大约）。

people.name: Mozi
people.known_for: Founded Mohism, teaching impartial love, opposition to aggressive war, and thrift.
people.known_for_zh: 创立墨家，主张兼爱、非攻、节用。
people.line_en: Love one another impartially and benefit one another.

people.name: Mencius
people.known_for: Leading Confucian after Confucius; taught that human nature is good and that rulers must serve the people.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子之后最重要的儒家学者，主张性善论和仁政。
people.line_zh: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
people.line_en: The people matter most, the state comes next, and the ruler matters least.

people.name: Zhuangzi
people.known_for: Daoist thinker whose witty parables (like the butterfly dream) celebrate freedom and naturalness.
people.known_for_zh: 道家代表人物，以寓言（如庄周梦蝶）倡导逍遥自然。
people.line_zh: 吾生也有涯，而知也无涯。
people.line_en: My life has a limit, but knowledge has none.

people.name: Xunzi
people.known_for: Confucian thinker who held that human nature is bad and must be shaped by learning and ritual; teacher of Han Fei and Li Si.
people.known_for_zh: 儒家学者，主张性恶论，强调学习与礼法，韩非、李斯的老师。
people.line_en: Blue dye comes from the indigo plant, yet it is bluer than the plant.

people.name: Qu Yuan
people.known_for: Chu poet and minister, China's first great named poet; the Dragon Boat Festival is said to honour him.
people.known_for_zh: 楚国诗人、大夫，中国第一位留名的伟大诗人，相传端午节为纪念他。
people.line_zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
people.line_en: The road ahead is long and far; I will search high and low.

people.name: Song Yu
people.known_for: Chu poet after Qu Yuan, a master of the early fu (rhapsody) style.
people.known_for_zh: 继屈原之后的楚国辞赋家。

people.name: Han Fei
people.known_for: Synthesised Legalism, arguing that a ruler governs through laws, methods and power.
people.known_for_zh: 法家集大成者，主张法、术、势相结合治国。

people.name: Gongsun Long
people.known_for: Logician of the School of Names, famous for the paradox 'a white horse is not a horse'.
people.known_for_zh: 名家代表人物，以“白马非马”之辩著称。

people.name: Zou Yan
people.known_for: Leading figure of the Yin-Yang school, who linked history to the cycle of the Five Phases.
people.known_for_zh: 阴阳家代表人物，提出五德终始说。

people.name: Shang Yang
people.known_for: Legalist reformer whose laws turned Qin into a centralized military power.
people.known_for_zh: 在秦推行变法，奠定秦国富强与统一的基础。

people.name: Wu Qi
people.place_zh: 安邑（魏国都城，今山西夏县）
people.known_for: Undefeated general of Wei and later reforming chancellor of Chu; author of a classic military text.
people.known_for_zh: 魏国名将，后在楚国主持变法，著《吴子》。

people.name: Li Kui
people.place_zh: 安邑（魏国都城，今山西夏县）
people.known_for: Wei chancellor whose reforms and Canon of Laws pioneered Legalist government.
people.known_for_zh: 魏文侯相，主持变法，著《法经》。

people.name: Ximen Bao
people.known_for: Magistrate of Ye who ended human sacrifices to the river god and dug twelve irrigation canals.
people.known_for_zh: 治邺破除“河伯娶妇”陋俗，开凿十二渠灌溉。

people.name: Sun Bin
people.known_for: Qi strategist and descendant of Sun Tzu who defeated Wei at Guiling and Maling.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国军师，围魏救赵，马陵之战大败魏军。

people.name: Pang Juan
people.place_zh: 大梁（魏国都城，今河南开封）
people.known_for: Wei general and rival of Sun Bin, killed in the ambush at Maling.
people.known_for_zh: 魏国大将，嫉害孙膑，马陵之战兵败身死。

people.name: Shen Buhai
people.known_for: Chancellor of Han and Legalist thinker who stressed administrative technique (shu).
people.known_for_zh: 韩国相，法家“术”派代表，使韩国内政修明。

people.name: Su Qin
people.known_for: Itinerant strategist famed for organizing the vertical alliance of states against Qin.
people.known_for_zh: 纵横家，倡导合纵抗秦，佩六国相印。

people.name: Zhang Yi
people.known_for: Qin chancellor and strategist who broke the anti-Qin alliance with his horizontal strategy.
people.known_for_zh: 秦国相，以连横之策瓦解六国合纵。

people.name: Bai Qi
people.known_for: Qin's most feared general, victor of Yique and Changping who annihilated huge enemy armies.
people.known_for_zh: 秦国名将，长平之战大破赵军，战国四大名将之一。

people.name: Lian Po
people.known_for: Veteran Zhao general who reconciled with Lin Xiangru by 'carrying thorns to beg forgiveness'.
people.known_for_zh: 赵国名将，负荆请罪，与蔺相如将相和。

people.name: Lin Xiangru
people.known_for: Zhao minister who returned the He Shi jade intact from Qin and placed the state above personal pride.
people.known_for_zh: 完璧归赵、渑池之会，以国为重与廉颇和好。

people.name: Zhao She
people.known_for: Zhao general who routed Qin at Eyu and father of the ill-fated Zhao Kuo.
people.known_for_zh: 赵国名将，阏与之战大破秦军，赵括之父。

people.name: Li Mu
people.known_for: Zhao general who crushed the Xiongnu and repelled Qin before being executed through Qin intrigue.
people.known_for_zh: 赵国名将，大破匈奴，屡败秦军，后遭反间被杀。

people.name: Yue Yi
people.known_for: Yan general who led a five-state coalition that captured over seventy cities of Qi.
people.known_for_zh: 燕国上将军，率五国联军伐齐，连下七十余城。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives c. 300 BC - c. 260 BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科作约前300年—约前260年。

people.name: Tian Dan
people.known_for: Qi commander who used a fire-ox stampede to break the Yan siege and restore Qi.
people.known_for_zh: 以火牛阵大破燕军，收复齐国七十余城。

people.name: Lord Mengchang
people.known_for: Qi aristocrat and chancellor famed for keeping thousands of retainers, one of the Four Lords.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国贵族，养士三千，战国四公子之一。

people.name: Lord Pingyuan
people.known_for: Zhao prince and chancellor who secured Chu aid during the siege of Handan, one of the Four Lords.
people.known_for_zh: 赵国相，邯郸之围时毛遂自荐求救于楚，战国四公子之一。

people.name: Lord Xinling
people.place_zh: 大梁（魏国都城，今河南开封）
people.known_for: Wei prince who stole the military tally to rescue Zhao from Qin, one of the Four Lords.
people.known_for_zh: 窃符救赵，率五国兵败秦，战国四公子之一。

people.name: Lord Chunshen
people.place_zh: 寿春（楚国都城，今安徽寿县）
people.known_for: Long-serving chancellor of Chu and patron of retainers, one of the Four Lords.
people.known_for_zh: 楚国令尹二十余年，战国四公子之一。

people.name: Fan Ju
people.known_for: Qin chancellor who devised the policy of 'befriending distant states and attacking nearby ones'.
people.known_for_zh: 秦国相，提出“远交近攻”战略。

people.name: Lü Buwei
people.known_for: Merchant turned Qin chancellor who sponsored the encyclopedic Lüshi Chunqiu.
people.known_for_zh: 由商人成为秦国相国，主编《吕氏春秋》。

people.name: Li Bing
people.place_zh: 都江堰（蜀郡，今四川都江堰）
people.known_for: Qin governor of Shu who built the Dujiangyan irrigation system, still in use today.
people.known_for_zh: 秦蜀郡守，主持修建都江堰，沿用至今。

people.name: Zheng Guo
people.known_for: Han hydraulic engineer sent to exhaust Qin, whose canal instead made the Guanzhong plain fertile.
people.known_for_zh: 韩国水工，为秦修建郑国渠，灌溉关中平原。

people.name: Bian Que
people.known_for: Legendary itinerant physician credited with pioneering pulse diagnosis.
people.known_for_zh: 战国名医，相传首创望闻问切中的切脉诊断。

people.name: Gan De
people.known_for: Qi astronomer who compiled one of the earliest star catalogues and may have observed a moon of Jupiter.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国天文学家，编制早期星表，或曾观测木星卫星。

people.name: Shi Shen
people.place_zh: 大梁（魏国都城，今河南开封）
people.known_for: Wei astronomer whose star catalogue, with Gan De's, formed the basis of Chinese stellar astronomy.
people.known_for_zh: 魏国天文学家，所著星表与甘德合称《甘石星经》。

people.name: Hui Shi
people.place_zh: 大梁（魏国都城，今河南开封）
people.known_for: Logician of the School of Names, Wei chancellor and debating partner of Zhuangzi.
people.known_for_zh: 名家代表，魏国相，与庄子论辩“濠梁之辩”。

people.name: Yang Zhu
people.place_zh: 大梁（魏国都城，今河南开封）
people.known_for: Philosopher of self-preservation who would not 'pluck one hair to benefit the world'.
people.known_for_zh: 主张“贵己”“为我”，“拔一毛而利天下不为也”。

people.name: Liezi
people.known_for: Daoist sage of Zheng to whom the Liezi, a classic of parables, is attributed.
people.known_for_zh: 郑国道家人物，相传著《列子》，“御风而行”。

people.name: Xu Xing
people.known_for: Leading Agriculturalist who argued that rulers should till the fields alongside the people.
people.known_for_zh: 农家代表，主张“贤者与民并耕而食”。

people.name: Shen Dao
people.known_for: Jixia Academy scholar who stressed positional power (shi) in Legalist thought.
people.known_for_zh: 稷下学者，法家“势”派代表。

people.name: Guiguzi
people.known_for: Reclusive master of persuasion and diplomacy, traditionally the teacher of Su Qin and Zhang Yi.
people.known_for_zh: 纵横家鼻祖，相传为苏秦、张仪之师。

people.name: Zisi
people.known_for: Grandson of Confucius traditionally credited with the Doctrine of the Mean.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子之孙，相传作《中庸》，后世尊为述圣。

people.name: Zengzi
people.known_for: Confucian disciple famed for filial piety and traditionally linked to the Great Learning.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子弟子，以孝著称，相传作《大学》，尊为宗圣。

people.name: Jing Ke
people.known_for: Retainer of Prince Dan of Yan who failed in his attempt to assassinate the King of Qin.
people.known_for_zh: 受燕太子丹之托刺秦王，图穷匕见，事败被杀。

people.name: King Wuling of Zhao
people.known_for: Zhao king who adopted nomadic dress and mounted archery, transforming Zhao's army.
people.known_for_zh: 推行“胡服骑射”改革，使赵国军力大增。

people.name: Chunyu Kun
people.known_for: Witty Jixia scholar and Qi envoy famed for using riddles to admonish rulers.
people.known_for_zh: 齐国稷下学者，滑稽多辩，以隐语讽谏君王。

people.name: Wei Liao
people.known_for: Military theorist who advised the King of Qin on unification and is linked to the Wei Liaozi.
people.known_for_zh: 为秦王献统一之策，任国尉，相传著《尉缭子》。

people.name: Wang Jian
people.known_for: Qin general who conquered Zhao and led 600,000 men to destroy Chu.
people.known_for_zh: 秦国名将，灭赵、率六十万大军灭楚。

people.name: Goujian
people.place_zh: 会稽（越国都城，今浙江绍兴）
people.known_for: King of Yue who 'slept on brushwood and tasted gall' to rebuild his state and annihilated Wu in 473 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 卧薪尝胆，十年生聚教训，终灭吴称霸。

people.name: Fan Li
people.place_zh: 会稽（越国都城，今浙江绍兴）
people.known_for: Adviser who helped Goujian destroy Wu, then retired to become a legendary merchant, later revered as a god of wealth.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐勾践灭吴后功成身退，经商致富，号陶朱公。

people.name: Zuo Qiuming
people.known_for: Lu historian traditionally credited with the Zuo Zhuan and Guoyu, masterpieces of early Chinese narrative history.
people.known_for_zh: 鲁国史官，相传著《左传》与《国语》。

people.name: Zigong
people.known_for: Eloquent disciple of Confucius, a skilled diplomat and wealthy merchant who reshaped interstate politics.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子弟子，善辞令外交，经商致富，“端木遗风”。

people.name: Lu Ban
people.known_for: Master carpenter and inventor of Lu, credited with siege ladders and many tools; patron saint of builders.
people.known_for_zh: 鲁国巧匠，相传发明云梯、锯等工具，被奉为木匠祖师。

people.name: Li Si
people.known_for: Qin chancellor and Legalist who standardised Chinese writing as small seal script.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝丞相、法家人物，主持以小篆统一文字。

works.title: Petition against the Expulsion of Guest Officials

people.name: Qin Shi Huang
people.known_for: First Emperor who unified China in 221 BC and standardized writing, coinage and measures.
people.known_for_zh: 统一六国，建立中国第一个中央集权王朝，统一文字度量衡。

people.name: Meng Tian
people.known_for: Qin general who drove back the Xiongnu and oversaw the building of the Great Wall.
people.known_for_zh: 北击匈奴，主持修筑万里长城与直道。

people.name: Meng Yi
people.known_for: Trusted minister of the First Emperor and brother of Meng Tian, executed after the succession plot.
people.known_for_zh: 秦始皇亲信上卿，蒙恬之弟，被胡亥赐死。

people.name: Zhao Gao
people.known_for: Eunuch who manipulated the Qin succession and famously 'called a deer a horse'.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝宦官，矫诏立胡亥，“指鹿为马”，祸乱朝政。

people.name: Wang Ben
people.known_for: Son of Wang Jian who conquered Wei, Yan and Qi, completing Qin's unification.
people.known_for_zh: 王翦之子，灭魏、燕、齐，完成秦统一。

people.name: Cheng Miao
people.known_for: Qin prison official traditionally credited with creating the clerical script.
people.known_for_zh: 秦朝狱吏，相传整理创制隶书。

people.name: Gao Jianli
people.known_for: Zhu musician and friend of Jing Ke who tried to kill the First Emperor with his lead-weighted instrument.
people.known_for_zh: 善击筑，荆轲好友，以筑击秦始皇未中被杀。

people.name: Chen Sheng
people.known_for: Leader of the Dazexiang Uprising, the first major revolt against the Qin.
people.known_for_zh: 大泽乡起义领袖，“王侯将相宁有种乎”。

people.name: Wu Guang
people.known_for: Co-leader of the Dazexiang Uprising with Chen Sheng.
people.known_for_zh: 与陈胜共同发动大泽乡起义。

people.name: Xiang Liang
people.known_for: Chu noble who raised rebellion against Qin at Kuaiji and mentored his nephew Xiang Yu.
people.known_for_zh: 起兵会稽反秦，项羽叔父，定陶战死。

people.name: Zhang Han
people.known_for: Qin general who led convict armies to crush early rebels before surrendering to Xiang Yu.
people.known_for_zh: 率骊山刑徒军镇压起义，后降项羽。

people.name: Liu Bang (Emperor Gaozu of Han)
people.known_for: Peasant-born rebel who defeated Xiang Yu and founded the Han dynasty in 202 BCE.
people.known_for_zh: 出身布衣，击败项羽，于前202年建立汉朝。

people.name: Xiao He
people.known_for: Liu Bang's first chancellor who secured supplies, preserved Qin records and drafted the Han legal code.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相，保障军需、收秦图籍，制定《九章律》。

people.name: Han Xin
people.known_for: Brilliant general who won Liu Bang's key campaigns, famed for fighting with backs to the river; later executed.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初名将，背水一战，为刘邦夺取天下，后遭诛杀。

people.name: Cao Shen
people.known_for: Second Han chancellor who kept Xiao He's policies unchanged, a model of Huang-Lao non-interference.
people.known_for_zh: 继萧何为相，萧规曹随，奉行黄老无为之治。

people.name: Zhang Cang
people.known_for: Han chancellor and mathematician credited with editing the Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art and setting the calendar.
people.known_for_zh: 汉初丞相、数学家，相传曾整理《九章算术》并定历法。

works.title: The Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art

capitals.name: Luoyi
capitals.note_zh: 自公元前770年起为周王都。

capitals.name: Xianyang
capitals.note: Moved here during Shang Yang's reforms.

capitals.name: Ying
capitals.note: Taken by the Qin general Bai Qi in 278 BCE.
capitals.note_zh: 公元前278年被秦将白起攻破。

capitals.name: Xinzheng
capitals.note: Han took it after conquering the state of Zheng.
